# Loan Contract Review and Updates

This document outlines critical actions required for existing loan contracts:

*   Review and investigate interest rates based on recent audit findings.
*   Assess default risk for the upcoming 2026 strategy.
*   Urgently review borrower credit scores.
*   Urgently update interest rates as required.
